observations.note: pdftotext extraction succeeds and produces thousands of characters, but the file's embedded OCR layer contains distorted words and malformed list markers on visual inspection of the rendered page 1 image.

selected_value_rationale: Extractable text is not evidence of accurate text. No confidence scores are available for the existing OCR layer. The rule text is excluded from the searchable slice; only the parent-instrument metadata and source link are retained.

observed_error_types: clause_marker_corruption (the same source clause '(f)' decoded two different wrong ways in two places: '(Call' and '(Ono')
missing_clause_marker (rule 11 item (i) has no label at all, though (ii)-(vi) are present)
letter_pair_word_merge_errors (e.g. 'InforrnationAct', 'pUblication', space replaced by colon or apostrophe)
complete_failure_on_handwritten_or_stamped_content (a handwritten reference stamp extracted as unreadable garbage)
complete_failure_on_non_latin_script (a bilingual Gazette footer line extracted as meaningless ASCII symbols)
assessment_pass2.conclusion: No confidence-threshold policy would have caught these; the retained embedded OCR layer carries no per-token confidence at all. Deferred, not attempted, in this session -- see the full writeup for future acceptance criteria.
